entries.message: Feature - Add library-wide duplicate watch cleanup for TV shows and movies
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Settings -> Tools -> Database Repairs now has a Remove Duplicate Watches tool with separate confirmed actions for TV shows and movies

Scans the whole library, keeps only the oldest watch date for each episode or movie, and shows the exact number of duplicate watches and affected items before asking for confirmation - the deletion cannot be undone once approved

Removed watches are pushed out as corrected canonical state to every connected platform (Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, Trakt), the same propagation already used by the per-season duplicate cleanup and manual watch-date edits
New GET /api/duplicate-watch-scan and POST /api/duplicate-watch-cleanup endpoints, both admin-only

entries.message: Fix - Stop Trakt episode dispatch from overwriting correct ids with a wrong TMDB title-search match
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Trakt sync for episodes no longer replaces an episode's own stored provider ids with a TMDB title-search result; existing ids now always win, and the lookup is skipped entirely once an episode already has one

Root cause of persistent duplicate/stuck Trakt entries for shows with short or ambiguous titles (e.g. G'wed): TMDB's search resolved to the wrong series, and that wrong id silently replaced the correct one on every dispatch, making Trakt unable to match the item to clear or add plays
Trakt dispatch now reports a real error (with the not_found detail) instead of a false success when Trakt cannot recognize the item

entries.message: Chore - Add one-off Plex match diagnostic endpoint
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Multiple shows (Silo, Game of Thrones) are reporting a genuine 'No matching item found' from findPlexItem for episodes that demonstrably exist in the library, and the detailed GUID/search trace that would explain why is gated behind the LOG_VERBOSE env var, which isn't set on the running deployment

Added POST /api/debug-plex-match (admin-only): runs findPlexItem for one watch record's exact media payload with verbose tracing forced on for just that call, then restores the previous verbose setting - no env var change or restart needed
Diagnostic only, no behavior change to any real sync path
